notes.title: Timothy vs the Aliens is here!
notes.content:
There are people screaming outside, weird lights and the TV is not working, can anyone tell us what is going on?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40839129/25a03228eddf70236d785aac4950e9370cf4224e.gif[/img]

The first UFOs have been sighted on Steam, run for cover! If you can't reach a shelter, go to Timothy's place. Aliens don't dare to enter there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40839129/0d502cc41dca02b1d2ea5bccaa2b9cb0ded5ccfb.gif[/img]

It's a good thing Timothy is in the city... we don't know if they don't like his taste, or if they know that our favourite gangster is armed to the teeth...

[previewyoutube=rcp_8IEC3BE;full][/previewyoutube]

Join the resistance, this is our city! They should have knocked on the door before landing...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40839129/62416b81de2e8897f1879094b98f14e1c3421e49.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Timothy vs the Aliens landing on July 22
notes.content:
If you were to conquer the Earth, would you start with a big city? Better a little place like Little Fish City... Fresh humans to eat and marvelous views to the sea. What could go wrong? 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40839129/0d502cc41dca02b1d2ea5bccaa2b9cb0ded5ccfb.gif[/img]

But one dish was not on the menu, a tough gangster in black and white named Timothy, accompanied by a good garnish of bullets, the power to slow down time, and lots and lots of luck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40839129/7f75e79830ba7fee7499c76d031e961fd657530e.gif[/img]

Play as Timothy and use his arsenal to take back HIS CITY and save his friends. An open-world noir city invaded by colorful aliens awaits you. Drive, explore and shoot all around because, this is your city!

[previewyoutube=rcp_8IEC3BE;full][/previewyoutube]
